# calibration

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:calibration`](gmeow-calibration.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/calibration>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/metacognition`](../../slices/metacognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Assigns a qualitative [`gmeow:CalibrationStatus`](../classes/gmeow-CalibrationStatus.md) ([`wellCalibrated`](../individuals/gmeow-wellCalibrated.md) / overconfident / underconfident) to a [`gmeow:MetacognitiveState`](../classes/gmeow-MetacognitiveState.md) — the direction of the gap between avowed confidence and accuracy. NOT functional: calibration is itself a vantage-indexed claim (a self-assessment and an external assessment may coexist, [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)), so several statuses may attach across frames. The range points only at the locally-owned closed value vocabulary.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:MetacognitiveState`](../classes/gmeow-MetacognitiveState.md) -> [`gmeow:CalibrationStatus`](../classes/gmeow-CalibrationStatus.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:calibration`](gmeow-calibration.md) from [`gmeow:MetacognitiveState`](../classes/gmeow-MetacognitiveState.md) to [`gmeow:CalibrationStatus`](../classes/gmeow-CalibrationStatus.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Dunning Kruger

- **Source:** [`slices/core/metacognition/examples/dunning-kruger.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/metacognition/examples/dunning-kruger.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-metacognition-examples-dunning-kruger)#example-slices-core-metacognition-examples-dunning-kruger

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example — Dunning–Kruger as a MODELLED metacognitive miscalibration, the
# second-order companion to the cognition slice's dunning-kruger.ttl. Where that
# example records two coexisting first-order gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency claims at
# divergent depths (Principle 9), this one turns the reflexive lens on Sam's OWN
# self-assessment: a gmeow:MetacognitiveState whose gmeow:metaTarget is Sam's
# self-attributed mastery, carrying gmeow:calibration gmeow:overconfident. The
# numeric Brier-style gap rides gmeow:calibrationError — a SOLVER-LAYER annotation
# (Principle 12), invisible to the reasoner. The calibration is itself a
# vantage-indexed claim (Principle 9): the assessor judges Sam overconfident; GMEOW
# records the judgement, it does not adjudicate a global verdict.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/metacognition/> .
@prefix wd:    <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/> .

# --- Second-order: Sam's metacognitive state reflecting on that self-assessment.
#     metaTarget is the reflexivity edge onto Sam's own first-order proficiency
#     (the same-agent ownership is a SHACL concern, not an OWL axiom); calibration
#     reads the direction of the confidence/accuracy gap.
ex:samSelfRegard a gmeow:MetacognitiveState ;
    gmeow:metaTarget  ex:samQuantumSelf ;
    gmeow:calibration gmeow:overconfident .
```

## Common Companion Terms

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the qualitative calibration of a metacognitive state — the direction of the confidence/accuracy gap — so consumers can flag overconfident self-assessments and surface underconfident ones.

### Avoid when

- Avoid pointing it outside the closed [`gmeow:CalibrationStatus`](../classes/gmeow-CalibrationStatus.md) vocabulary, avoid using it to carry the numeric magnitude (that is [`gmeow:calibrationError`](gmeow-calibrationError.md)), and avoid forcing exactly one status — a self-assessment and an external assessment may coexist as vantage-indexed claims ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:calibration`](gmeow-calibration.md) from a [`gmeow:MetacognitiveState`](../classes/gmeow-MetacognitiveState.md) at a [`gmeow:CalibrationStatus`](../classes/gmeow-CalibrationStatus.md) individual; carry whose-assessment on the statement via [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) when contested, and attach the numeric [`gmeow:calibrationError`](gmeow-calibrationError.md) when a solver has computed it.

### Examples

- ex:samDoubtsOwnGrasp [`gmeow:calibration`](gmeow-calibration.md) [`gmeow:overconfident`](../individuals/gmeow-overconfident.md).
